install_steps: Download latest release: VERSION=$(curl -Ls -o /dev/null -w %{url_effective} https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/releases/latest | sed -e 's/^.*\/v//') && curl -LO https://github.com/AsamK/signal-cli/releases/download/v${VERSION}/signal-cli-${VERSION}.tar.gz
note: Also available as GraalVM native build (no JVM required): replace .tar.gz with -Linux-native.tar.gz. Requires phone number for registration. Data stored in ~/.local/share/signal-cli/. Supports daemon mode with JSON-RPC interface on TCP (localhost:7583) or HTTP (localhost:8080).
